newsitem.title: USA: Surge Components adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Surge Components adopts rights plan.

text.p: Surge Components Inc's board of directors has adopted a shareholder protection rights plan, commonly referred to as a poison pill, to assure that shareholders receive a fair price if there is a takeover.

The company said in a statement on Monday that it is not aware of any effort to takeover the company, but it adopted the rights plan in view of the low market prices for the company's securities. The company's shares traded at 31/32 today.
Under the plan, each shareholder of record on July 10, 1997 will receive two common share purchase rights for each outstanding share.
Also, Surge Components said its board has authorized the repurchase of up to $500,000 of its common stock in the open market.
